# M12-S2: linker reachability sinks fail under logos; dead code passes.
# Each case uses its own fixture with a replace-based dependency.
# RED expectation: no linker audit exists yet, so every `! logos build`
# sees a successful build. Fail-cases build with -o because a bare
# `./...` build collides with the ./cmd directory name before linking.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Case A: Go dep reaches os.StartProcess through os/exec -> fail, PLAN 13.2 format.
cd a/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/s2a$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/xdep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/xdep\.Init\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
stderr 'os\.startProcess\(\) +at .*os/exec_posix\.go:\d+'
stderr 'transitive_exec_allowlist'
cd ../..

# Case B: dep imports os/exec but never calls it (dead code) -> passes.
cd b/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/s2b$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/s2b$GOEXE
stdout '^dead-ok$'
cd ../..

# Case C: reflection through reflect.Value.MethodByName counts as reachable -> fail.
cd c/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/s2c$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/rdep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/rdep\.Init\(\)'
stderr 'os\.startProcess\(\) +at .*os/exec_posix\.go:\d+'
cd ../..

# Case D: interface dispatch is followed through synthetic edges -> fail.
cd d/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/s2d$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/idep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/idep\.Init\(\)'
stderr 'os\.startProcess\(\) +at .*os/exec_posix\.go:\d+'
cd ../..

# Case E: diamond call graph reports the shortest chain.
cd e/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/s2e$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'edep\.short\(\)'
stderr 'edep\.run\(\)'
! stderr 'edep\.long'
! stderr 'edep\.mid'
cd ../..

# Case F: Go dep reached from a Go main reports the same chain format.
cd f/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/s2f$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/fdep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/fdep\.Init\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
stderr 'os\.startProcess\(\) +at .*os/exec_posix\.go:\d+'
cd ../..

# Case G: cgo reachability reports unauthorized_cgo (Go module: M0 policy silent).
[cgo] cd g/main
[cgo] ! logos build -o $WORK/bin/s2g$GOEXE ./cmd
[cgo] stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_cgo\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/cdep'' reaches ''runtime\.cgocall'''
[cgo] stderr 'example\.com/cdep\.Ping\(\)'
[cgo] cd ../..

# Case H: allowlisted dep passes and runs.
cd h/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/s2h$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/s2h$GOEXE
stdout '^hi$'
cd ../..

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/xmain

go 1.27

require example.com/xdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/xdep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/xdep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/xdep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	_ = cmd.Run()
}

-- b/main/go.mod --
module example.com/bmain

go 1.27

require example.com/bdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/bdep => ../dep

-- b/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/bdep"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(dep.Init()) }

-- b/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/bdep

go 1.27

-- b/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

var _ = exec.ErrNotFound

//go:noinline
func Init() string { return "dead-ok" }

-- c/main/go.mod --
module example.com/cmain

go 1.27

require example.com/rdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/rdep => ../dep

-- c/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- c/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/rdep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- c/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/rdep

go 1.27

-- c/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"os/exec"
	"reflect"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	m := reflect.ValueOf(cmd).MethodByName("Start")
	m.Call(nil)
}

-- d/main/go.mod --
module example.com/dmain

go 1.27

require example.com/idep v0.0.0

replace example.com/idep => ../dep

transitive_exec = "deny"

-- d/main/cmd/main.lgo --

	"fmt"

	"example.com/idep"
)

	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- d/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/idep

go 1.27

-- d/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

type starter interface {
	Start() error
}

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	var s starter = exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	_ = s.Start()
}

-- e/main/go.mod --
module example.com/emain

go 1.27

require example.com/edep v0.0.0

replace example.com/edep => ../dep

-- e/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- e/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/edep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- e/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/edep

go 1.27

-- e/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		long()
	} else {
		short()
	}
}

//go:noinline
func long() { mid() }

//go:noinline
func mid() { run() }

//go:noinline
func short() { run() }

//go:noinline
func run() {
	_ = exec.Command("echo", "hi").Run()
}

-- g/main/go.mod --
module example.com/gmain

go 1.27

require example.com/cdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/cdep => ../dep

-- g/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/cdep/**"]

-- g/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cdep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Ping()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- g/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/cdep

go 1.27

-- g/dep/dep.go --
package dep

/*
int fortytwo() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

//go:noinline
func Ping() { fmt.Println(C.fortytwo()) }
